scope: Pilot history and evidence boundaries, not acceptance for a recipient account.

Dot Review reports 589 aligned slots and 565 semantic pairs; QA reports full structural checks and 39 semantic samples from 13 pages. Claims are read from actual archived reports, not independently repeated here.

review_and_qa.result: Two separate Review and QA agents reported started, with reports tied to artifact hashes.

hourly_smoke.result: A synthetic one-page TEST PDF was reported detected without a new user message during the scheduled run, translated, independently reviewed and read back from Drive.
hourly_smoke.scope_limit: One reported small cycle; raw execution logs, output and device independence were not independently verified.

targeted_correction.result: Version 3 index-format correction accepted in Dot QA; source and target hashes recorded in QA_ALGORITHM_DELTA.v3.md. Original baseline preserved; this is a formatting delta review, not a full new translation review.

token_accounting.result: Per-book token and measurement-coverage columns reported added. Actual totals for previous books and exact current model identity were unavailable and recorded as unknown.

access_boundary: Initially the reviewer connector lacked access. A newly available account-specific Drive connection subsequently downloaded the Dot report bundle and verified its package integrity. Actual recipient setup and the book-processing claims were not independently replayed.
not_proven: Exact current model/runtime and complete token costs

checkpoint_restore.scope: Two controlled restores of a completed checkpoint into empty folders; not live crash/interrupted-translation recovery.
